designs.name: SERV
designs.upstream_size: Artix-7: about 125 LUT and 164 FF; architecture-dependent
designs.notes: Best fast regression after the eight-cell fixture. The external-register-file synthesis wrapper can isolate LUT/FF placement before RAM support.

designs.name: PicoRV32
designs.notes: Single-file RTL and an upstream xcvu3p implementation result make this the preferred Phase 2 growth target. Requires a larger ArchitectureDB window and either LUTRAM/carry support or a logic-only synthesis policy.

designs.name: secworks AES
designs.notes: Mature iterative AES-128/256 core. Good density and routing stress test once the architecture window grows beyond the current 512 LUT/FF slots.

designs.name: Ibex
designs.upstream_size: Yosys ASIC estimates: 16.85-66.02 kGE depending on configuration
designs.notes: Production-quality CPU with packages, parameters, primitive dependencies and memories. Use after the SystemVerilog/FuseSoC frontend and macro handling are stable.

designs.name: VTR classic Verilog benchmarks
designs.notes: Useful flattened CAD benchmarks. Review per-benchmark provenance and exclude latch/multiclock cases from the initial single-clock semantic envelope.
